title: Modeled CDC backlog during recovery
method: Synthetic source rate 2,000 changes/s, outage 600 s→1,200,000 backlog. Apply rate 3,000/s leaves net drain 1,000/s. Backlog after 600 recovery seconds is 600,000; after 1,200 seconds it is 0. Assumes constant rates and retained history.
alt: Modeled CDC backlog during recovery. Restart: 1.2e+06 changes; After 10 minutes: 600000 changes; After 20 minutes: 0 changes. Illustrative values.
